Params: {3: 'The two of you fight side by side, carving a path through the pirates.'}
{3: 'The ship is shaking more violently by the second. Damage control has failed completely, and warning lights flash across the bulkheads in blinding red.'}
{3: "The main engine room is flooded, power is failing, and the fire is spreading. No one needs the broken displays to understand what happens next. The ship's dying groans say enough."}
{3: 'You both burst through the bridge hatch.'}

{3: 'The great ornate navigation clock has stopped. Every window is shattered, and the wind tears through the bridge, scattering papers in every direction. The floor is covered in debris, and the last remaining life jacket slides back and forth as the ship rolls.'}
{3: 'The helm stands silent at the center.'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Adelyde', 3: 'Are you really going through with this?', 4: '1', 18: '100020530'}
{3: 'Compared with the apocalyptic roar outside, the bridge is quiet, filled only with the irregular beeping of damaged instruments. The chaos beyond makes the silence inside feel even heavier.'}
{3: 'You stare out at the sea ahead.'}
{3: "She does know. The words were only meant to comfort you, though she isn't sure why she felt compelled to say them."}
{2: 'Adelyde', 3: 'You need to understand this. Under F.O.S. simulation regulations, dying in the tactical simulation system can damage your consciousness.', 4: '1', 18: '100020532'}
{2: "That's the second time you've said that.", 3: '60'}
{2: '"Repeat the lesson until the student remembers it."', 3: '61'}
{2: "I don't know who you are, but you sound a lot like a teacher.", 3: '62'}
{3: "She can't tell whether you're merely trying to lighten the mood or whether you've actually noticed something."}
{3: "Adelyde doesn't answer. She has never been good at responding to things like this."}
{2: 'Adelyde', 3: "There's a fine line between courage and recklessness.", 4: '1', 18: '100020535'}
{2: 'Adelyde', 3: 'Are you doing this to prove something?', 4: '1', 18: '100020536'}
{2: 'Adelyde', 3: '...This simulation is based on a real war. The outcome has already been written.', 4: '1', 18: '100020538'}
{2: 'Adelyde', 3: 'Gray suffered a crushing defeat, losing most of its elite forces. The balance of power between the two factions changed forever.', 4: '1', 18: '100020539'}
{2: 'Adelyde', 3: "Whatever future you're trying to create, you can't make it real here.", 4: '1', 18: '100020540'}
{2: 'Adelyde', 3: 'History will follow the course it already took.', 4: '1', 18: '100020541'}
{2: "Humanity can't keep repeating the same mistakes. Not while I have a choice.", 3: '82'}
{2: "I've seen what people long for when they're not caught in war.", 3: '83'}
{2: 'Adelyde', 3: 'What kind of history can you change by keeping your people alive?', 4: '1', 18: '100020542'}
{2: 'Adelyde', 3: 'Can you guarantee that peace will follow?', 4: '1', 18: '100020543'}
{2: 'At least some of the people who still want peace will survive.', 3: '86'}
{2: "As long as people like that remain, there's still a chance.", 3: '87'}
{2: 'Adelyde', 3: "You're paying a very real price for a possibility.", 4: '1', 18: '100020544'}
{2: "Which is why I'm not being reckless.", 3: '90'}
{2: "I'm pretty confident in my reflexes.", 3: '91', 4: "I'm pretty confident in my combat experience.", 5: '94'}
{3: 'She repeats it, and something about her tone strikes you as odd.'}
{2: "The console is outdated and has to be operated by hand. That's why I need to stay behind.", 3: '98'}
{2: "Once the ship gets close enough, the heading won't shift much.", 3: '99'}
{2: 'I just need to catch the right moment and get clear.', 3: '100'}
{2: "I promise I won't die in here.", 3: '101'}
{2: "You don't trust me?", 3: '103', 4: "I thought we'd built up enough trust by now.", 5: '103'}
{2: 'Your fleet needs you, and so do my soldiers.', 3: '107'}
{2: 'Adelyde', 3: "I'm staying with you until the end.", 4: '1', 18: '100020550'}
{2: 'You could get caught in the blast.', 3: '110', 4: 'I can do this alone.', 5: '111', 6: '...Thank you.', 7: '113'}
{2: 'Adelyde', 3: "That's not for you to worry about.", 4: '1', 18: '100020551'}
{2: 'Adelyde', 3: '"We\'re equals. You don\'t have the authority to order me." I\'m repeating your own words back to you.', 4: '1', 18: '100020552'}
{2: 'Adelyde', 3: "You don't need to thank me. I'm only doing what I believe is right.", 4: '1', 18: '100020553'}
{2: 'Adelyde', 3: "Besides, in the end, I didn't really do much to help you. It was your own actions that led me to make that decision.", 4: '1', 18: '100020554'}
{2: 'Adelyde', 3: "There's only one thing I want you to understand.", 4: '1', 18: '100020555'}
{2: 'Adelyde', 3: "Whether your plan works or not, whatever score the system gives you—you didn't lose.", 4: '1', 18: '100020557'}
{2: "Whatever happens now, the result doesn't matter to me anymore.", 3: '123'}
{2: 'Could I ask you for one last favor?', 3: '125'}
{2: 'I need to check the situation outside.', 3: '128'}
{2: 'Can you see whether there are any pirates left on deck?', 3: '129'}
{3: 'The moment Adelyde steps outside, your exhausted body finally gives way and you stumble.'}
{3: 'A stray shot must have hit you. Pain inside the tactical simulation system has always felt real.'}
{3: "There's no time to think about it. You grab the only life jacket from the floor and hurry out of the bridge."}
{3: "You know exactly what she meant about the damage to your consciousness. That's why you can't let her take the same risk."}
{1: '1', 3: 'On deck, Adelyde carefully surveys the area.'}
{3: 'Before she can finish, the deck jerks violently beneath her feet.'}
{3: 'The flooded ship finally loses its balance.'}

{3: "The ship's center of gravity shifts instantly. The deck pitches like something has overturned it from below, and everything loose slides toward port in a single violent wave—rigging, broken planks, and overturned ammunition crates sweeping across the deck."}
{3: 'Before she can regain her footing, a pair of hands grabs her from behind.'}
{3: 'You pull the life jacket around her, your movements gentle but firm, then snap the buckle shut.'}
{3: "Then you use the ship's tilt to push her straight toward the edge of the deck."}
{3: 'It happens so fast that only half a sound escapes her throat.'}
{1: '1', 3: 'The world seems to stop. The clouds freeze, the wind goes silent, and only you remain at the center of it all, smiling down at her from the dying ship.'}
{3: 'The moment Adelyde hits the water, she sees you turn and run back toward the bridge.'}
{3: "Adjusting the course. Bringing her onto the deck. The life jacket. You'd planned every step to get her out."}
{3: 'For a moment, she forgets that none of this is real and wishes time would stop right there.'}
{3: 'Adelyde hits the water and is immediately hauled onto a life raft by several pairs of hands.'}
{3: "The moment she leapt toward the Gray flagship, Red's soldiers had rushed after her in lifeboats."}
{2: 'Red First Officer', 3: "Ma'am, the waves are getting worse! We'll get you back to the ship!", 18: '100020562'}
{3: "The place where she hit the water is also the closest point to Red's lifeboats. While Adelyde had been focused on saving you, you'd been quietly calculating a way to save her."}
{3: 'The engine roars with deafening force, like the final cry of a dying beast.'}
{3: 'The storm that had been threatening for so long finally arrives.'}
{3: 'Carrying only one person, the ship tears through the white waves and driving rain, a red-hot wedge aimed straight at the heart of the pirate formation.'}
{3: 'Flames erupt on impact, flooding the black-and-white world with violent color.'}
{3: 'Then a blinding red light swallows everything.'}
{3: 'Fire rises over the distant sea. The Gray flagship is gone beneath the waves.'}
{2: 'Adelyde', 3: "Even a callsign would've been better than... nothing.", 18: '100020565'}
{3: 'She sits in the rocking lifeboat as rain streams down her face, soaking her hair and uniform.'}
{3: "Primary participant's flagship destroyed. No possibility of recovery detected. Casualty confirmed. Tactical simulation system terminating automatically."}
{1: '1', 3: "But the image of that burning sea remains before Adelyde's eyes."}
{3: 'She knows it was only a simulation, yet the smell of blood, oil, and gunsmoke still clings to her senses, as if recounting the weight of that fateful choice.'}
{2: 'Adelyde', 3: "...And that's why I want to help you.", 4: '1', 18: '100020567'}
{3: "As an F.O.S. combat instructor, she understands the system's scoring rules better than most."}
{3: 'She begins considering how to give the student the fair evaluation they deserve without compromising the integrity of the battle.'}
{3: 'She turns to the console and brings up the data from the exercise.'}
{3: "Battle record, duration, resource losses, scoring criteria... and the student's identification code."}

{3: "To protect the fairness of the assessment, the system doesn't display the participant's real name. But anyone familiar with the battle's coding rules can easily derive the student number from the post-battle data."}
{3: "Adelyde won't misuse her privileges to look up the student's name..."}
{3: 'That short string of characters seems to carry an impossible weight, drawing her eyes back again and again.'}
{3: 'Then her gaze drops to the final score.'}
{3: "A shadow settles between her brows. This isn't what she expected to see, and it isn't the score the student deserves."}
{2: 'Adelyde', 3: '...Nameless soldier, your sacrifice will not go without honor.', 4: '1', 18: '100020568'}
{3: "Not as an instructor, but as a fellow soldier, she writes a record of the student's courage."}
